description: TY2025: same corporation as fixture 94 but a year earlier — NO charitable floor yet (the OBBBA 1% floor starts in 2026). Charity fully deductible at $100,000 (= the 10% ceiling exactly). TI = 1,000,000 - 100,000 - 65,000 = 835,000 -> 21% = $175,350.00. The 94/95 pair pins the year boundary.
